died.name: Sarah Good
died.desc: American woman accused of witchcraft during the Salem witch trials
died.cause: to Reverend Nicholas Noyes prior to execution by hanging
died.last_words: You are a lyer; I am no more a Witch than you are a Wizard, and if you take away my Life, God will give you Blood to drink.

died.name: Suleiman I of Persia
died.cause: According to the French cleric, Martin Gaudereau

died.name: William Wilberforce
died.last_words: Thank God that I have lived to see the day when England is willing to give twenty millions for the abolition of slavery.

died.name: Vincent van Gogh
died.cause: to his brother sometime before dying of (presumably) a self-inflicted gunshot wound

died.name: John Barbirolli
died.cause: to his wife after awakening during the night
died.last_words: Anyway, I can get a good rest in the morning. There's no rehearsal till three.

died.name: Jonathan Capewell
died.cause: The 16-year-old from Oldham died from a heart attack brought on by the buildup of butane and propane in his blood after excessive use of deodorant sprays. He was reported to have been obsessed with personal hygiene.

born.name: Clement Vallandigham
born.cause: The American politician and lawyer, who was defending a man accused of murder, accidentally shot himself while demonstrating how the victim might have done so. His client was acquitted.

born.name: Elisabeth von Thadden
born.desc: German progressive educator and resistance fighter
born.cause: before her execution by the Nazi regime
born.last_words: Put an end, Lord, to all our sufferings.
